# Clyra Video Editor runtime

This directory contains the browser runtime from EffectCraft `v0.8.0`, obtained from:

`https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/releases/tag/v0.8.0`

Upstream release archive SHA-256:

`59426cdd519ea1480215a58158ec0b36a31e6a1163ddd8715f3869caf509069d`

EffectCraft is licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0. The unmodified license texts are included here as `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE`.

The bundled browser runtime has only display-name string substitutions so the embedded editor appears as a native Clyra surface. Its editing engine, file formats, storage model, and APIs are otherwise the upstream `v0.8.0` release.
